_comment: Project fidelity config for SPX 换汇 (917:8262). Tolerances mirror account-states harness. fontAliases route HarmonyOS Sans → app-shipped Plus Jakarta Sans.

deviations.reason: Balance row right group anchors to the cell's right edge via absolute right:0. Figma reports the layer x=214/212; PJS glyph widths are tighter than HarmonyOS Sans (figma's spec font), so the right group's natural width is ~11px narrower than figma's layer width. Right edge matches; left-edge x drifts ~10-12px. Same artifact as account-states harness's buysell deviations.
Same as 可用余额: above — balance row right-amount, anchored to right edge of the 326-wide row. PJS-rendered amount sits ~11px right of figma's HarmonyOS reference.
Same as 10,000.00 USD — buy-cell balance right-amount, same PJS-width artifact.

Exchange-info 汇率 row right group (value + ⓘ icon) anchored to right edge. PJS-rendered '1:7.162' is ~7-8px narrower than figma's reported w=42, so the value left edge sits a few px right of figma. Right edge anchored correctly.
Exchange-info 卖出 row right amount — same right-edge-anchored PJS-width artifact.
Exchange-info 实际到账金额 row right amount — same PJS-width artifact (fs14 fw700).
Fee row 手续费: right amount — same right-edge-anchored PJS-width artifact.
